spots.text: Pinned inside the door: a photograph of this hall, printed the right way round. Somebody has written on it: DO NOT BELIEVE THE WHITE ONE.

secrets.name: The Positive
secrets.text: Inside the cabinet at the middle of the hall the colours come back: red chair, green lamp, brown books. You had forgotten what they were. You stay longer than you meant to.

meta.label: The Negative
meta.blurb: The shelves are white and the lampshades are black, and the lamps shine black light that somehow shows you everything. It is only the library, printed the wrong way.
